name: mash_taxscreen
summary: Mash 2.3 'mash taxscreen': the Kraken-style taxonomic report of query references contained in a pool, byte for byte.
short: Mash taxscreen: Kraken-style taxonomic report (LCA of the references that share a hash, clade / taxon counts) of a pool of sequences, with names.dmp / nodes.dmp.
description: Mash 2.3 'mash taxscreen': the Kraken-style taxonomic report of how well query references are contained in a pool of sequences (the pass of mash screen; the taxonomy ID of a reference is that of the mapping file or the number after 'taxid' in its comment; the hashes shared by several references go to their lowest common ancestor in the taxonomy dump). Byte for byte equal to the installed program on 300 random runs.

text: The report: the header line and one line per taxon from the root down.

errors: A node whose parent is missing from nodes.dmp (the program uses an uninitialised pointer: refused)
At least one input is required

example.title: Two references of one genus screened against a read of the first
example.prompt: Screen this read against the two reference genomes and report the taxonomy.

input.namesDump:
1	|	root	|		|	scientific name	|
5	|	GenusX	|		|	scientific name	|
10	|	GenusX alpha	|		|	scientific name	|
11	|	GenusX beta	|		|	scientific name	|
